value.answer: Tomorrow in Denver looks mostly partly sunny, with a high around 65. Winds are north-northeast at 6 to 10 mph, becoming east to northeast in the afternoon, with gusts up to 17 mph. Rain and showers may move in Tuesday evening, about a 30% chance after 3 pm, and rain chances climb past 40% from 8 PM into the early morning. Overnight lows are in the 30s to low 40s with rain at times.
